claim: The pre-HPC programme is complete as a declared executable truncation.
scope_or_limitation: Analytic setup, reduced pointwise kernels, regression tests, vertex/ghost initialization, singlet BSE control, resource tiers, and stop conditions are specified.

claim: The pointwise hard/Born/LPM/HTL/overlap table is an exact arbitrary-off-shell Standard-Model Higgs self-energy.
scope_or_limitation: The table is a reduced PT/BFM benchmark anchored to controlled on-shell and integrated rates.
Maximum relative spread where the signal exceeds 1e-9 is 5.603e-16.

claim: The finite transverse vertex basis is the complete thermal non-Abelian basis.
scope_or_limitation: Four transverse tensors are used as a separable-BSE initialization; the production basis must be expanded and evolved.

claim: The declared common-scalar matter-ghost kernel satisfies the STI.
The complete finite-temperature matrix-valued matter-ghost problem is solved.
scope_or_limitation: It remains a functional-equation and HPC acceptance target.

claim: A finite three-loop 3PI truncation is automatically gauge invariant.
scope_or_limitation: Ward, Slavnov-Taylor, Nielsen, KMS, conservation, and singlet-observable diagnostics must be monitored explicitly.

claim: The H-dagger-H control correlator includes a conserving ladder.
scope_or_limitation: The separable ladder has an algebraic residual of 2.651e-16 and a nonnegative positive-frequency spectrum.

claim: The package is ready for a pilot PT/BFM-constrained two-time run.
scope_or_limitation: The pilot equations, grids, resource model, checkpointing, and acceptance thresholds are defined.
